notes.title: Flipside v0.3.2
notes.content:
Hello Flipsiders,

I just pushed up the first of many updates for Flipside Genesis. It's a pretty minor one with a few bug fixes and updates, including:

- Preliminary work towards a refactor of ship subsystems, which will allow system specific damage, upgrading systems, etc.
- General bug fixes, including an issue closing the missions menu and some bad collision geo in the hangar (thanks @pebblegarden).

As always, let me know your thoughts!

Cheers,

GrimFoxJones
